name: Cascoon
description: The Cocoon Pokémon. Cascoon makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokémon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.

abilities.name: Mudar
abilities.description: Si este Pokémon es afectado por un efecto de estado negativo, tira un d4 al final de cada uno de sus turnos. En un resultado de 4, se cura el estado negativo.
